tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind lists and the board list. Replaced by the user's backdrop when one is set.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, header, popups, dialogs, inputs. Painted at the user's UI opacity over a backdrop.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: List column ground behind its cards. The default list has no ground.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card outlines, header bottom, popup outlines. Decorative, carries no meaning.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders: inputs, checkboxes, secondary buttons, colour circles, the empty emoji placeholder. 3:1 on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and titles on bg, surface, surface-sunken and every task tint.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Notes, meta lines, done task titles, field labels, placeholders. 4.5:1 on bg, surface, surface-sunken and task tints.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The brand colour. Primary buttons, links, checked checkboxes, the selected colour circle. Dark value is the spec's #B7C4DE; light is a darker shade of it, 6.5:1 on surface.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Hover ground of quiet controls, the selected search result, inline edit hover. accent and ink read on it.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent and accent-hover fills.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus outline, offset 2px, on every focusable element. Also the brief highlight of a task opened by its #task-<id> anchor.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Due date reached or past, error toasts, the OK button of a destructive confirm dialog, delete icon hover. Text on surface and danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the due-now date badge.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on danger fills.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Due date 1 to 3 days ahead. Text on warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the due-soon date badge.

tokens.name: inverse
tokens.usage: Toast ground for status messages.

tokens.name: on-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on inverse.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Layer behind the confirm dialog, singleview, share dialog and search popup.

tokens.name: task-red
tokens.usage: Colour circle for the task colour red.

tokens.name: task-red-tint
tokens.usage: Card ground of a red task.

tokens.name: task-orange
tokens.usage: Colour circle for orange.

tokens.name: task-orange-tint
tokens.usage: Card ground of an orange task.

tokens.name: task-yellow
tokens.usage: Colour circle for yellow.

tokens.name: task-yellow-tint
tokens.usage: Card ground of a yellow task.

tokens.name: task-green
tokens.usage: Colour circle for green.

tokens.name: task-green-tint
tokens.usage: Card ground of a green task.

tokens.name: task-blue
tokens.usage: Colour circle for blue.

tokens.name: task-blue-tint
tokens.usage: Card ground of a blue task.

tokens.name: task-purple
tokens.usage: Colour circle for purple.

tokens.name: task-purple-tint
tokens.usage: Card ground of a purple task.

tokens.name: task-grey
tokens.usage: Colour circle for grey.

tokens.name: task-grey-tint
tokens.usage: Card ground of a grey task.

tokens.name: task-turquoise
tokens.usage: Colour circle for turquoise. The spec fixes it at #B7C4DE, the accent's dark value.

tokens.name: task-turquoise-tint
tokens.usage: Card ground of a turquoise task.

tokens.name: qr-ground
tokens.usage: Ground of the TOTP QR code in both themes, so authenticator apps read it.

tokens.name: qr-ink
tokens.usage: Modules of the TOTP QR code in both themes.

families.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace

styles.name: board-title
styles.usage: Board name in the board page title, inline editable.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: List headers, board list sections, settings sections, dialog titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Delete this list? Its tasks move to the default list.
styles.usage: Board names in the board list, dialog messages, inputs, settings copy.

styles.name: task-title
styles.usage: Task title on a card. Wraps, never truncates.

styles.name: note
styles.sample: Blue ones, not the white variety. Ask at the market on Saturday.
styles.usage: Task note on a card in ink-muted, cut after 3 lines.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, field labels, menu items, toasts.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Due date badge, Json export link, role labels, footer.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: API key, MCP key, TOTP secret and recovery codes on the settings page.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a due badge and its marker, inline edit padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a list, card vertical padding, list inner padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card horizontal padding, button padding, gap inside popups.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between list columns, page gutter on mobile, popup padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutter from 768px, space between board page title and lists.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space between settings sections and between board list sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, due badges, icon buttons, inline edit hover.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Task cards, buttons, inputs, board list entries, emoji control, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: List columns, singleview, dialogs, popups.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Colour circles.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Task cards and board list entries.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Singleview, dialogs, popups, emoji picker, menus, toasts.

tokens.name: list-width
tokens.usage: Width of a list column from 769px. Lists stack full width below.

tokens.name: singleview-width
tokens.usage: Width of the task singleview popup.

tokens.name: dialog-width
tokens.usage: Width of confirm, share and search dialogs.

tokens.name: breakpoint-stack
tokens.usage: Up to this width lists stack vertically and backdrop mobile CSS applies.

tokens.name: viewport-min
tokens.usage: Narrowest screen every page supports.

tokens.name: ui-opacity-min
tokens.usage: Lowest UI opacity a user can set, keeps text readable over a backdrop.

tokens.name: ui-opacity-max
tokens.usage: Default UI opacity: surfaces fully opaque.
